name: Watchlistarr
description: Sync RSS Plex watchlists in realtime with Sonarr and Radarr https://github.com/nylonee/watchlistarr

variables.name: Sonarr API Key
variables.description: Your Sonarr API Key, found in Sonarr UI Settings -> General

variables.name: Radarr API Key
variables.description: Your Sonarr API Key, found in Sonarr UI Settings -> General

variables.name: Refresh Interval (Seconds)
variables.description: The number of seconds to wait between syncing watchlists

variables.name: Sonarr Quality Profile
variables.description: The Sonarr Quality Profile you'd like new shows to inherit

variables.name: Sonarr Root Folder
variables.description: Your Sonarr Root folder, found in Sonarr Settings

variables.name: Radarr Quality Profile
variables.description: The Radarr Quality Profile you'd like new movies to inherit

variables.name: Radarr Root Folder
variables.description: Your Radarr Root folder, found in Radarr Settings

variables.name: Sonarr Bypass Exclusions
variables.description: Set to true to bypass excluded sonarr lists

variables.name: Radarr Bypass Exclusions
variables.description: Set to true to bypass excluded radarr lists

variables.name: Sonarr Default Season Monitoring
variables.description: Default season monitoring. If not set, will be 'all'. Possible values are all, future, missing, existing, pilot, firstSeason, latestSeason, none
